changelog:
- Major rework: Refactored from a Git-style snapshot/restore tool to a task-level time-reversal “time machine” for OpenClaw.
- Replaced all previous Python scripts with a new Node.js implementation.
- Added automatic and manual rollback features triggered by task duration or user action.
- Introduced state snapshotting at task start, with customizable save/restore logic.
- Simplified API and documentation to focus on integrating time-based rollback for long-running tasks.
summary: Provides automated and manual rollback of long-running OpenClaw tasks by saving and restoring state snapshots to handle errors or unexpected issues.
